How should I settle whether a /rvw-pr fork can get the cloud GitHub tools (H1: never, H2: only when it starts before the GitHub server connects)?

options.label: No-post probe skill (Recommended)
options.description: I push a throwaway forked skill (agent: reviewer, lists its tools, posts nothing) to a scratch branch and run it twice in fresh sessions: once as the first prompt, once after GitHub connects. That settles H1 vs H2 with nothing posted. I then archive the stuck session; #1162 is reviewed once the fix holds.

options.label: Approve the post there
options.description: You answer the pending question in session '/rvw-pr 1162 (re-run after BK-459)' yourself. It posts the review to #1162, and the result settles the question as a side effect. If H1 holds, nothing posts and we learn the same thing.

options.label: Post the 2 findings myself
options.description: I post the re-run's 2 findings to #1162 from this session, which has the posting tools, and settle H1 vs H2 later. This is the hand-posting you asked to avoid.

questions.question: Merge #1163 now, or after one Claude review?

options.label: One /rvw-pr pass first (Recommended)
options.description: I run /rvw-pr 1163 in this session (MCP is connected, so it posts), then fix any finding per /fix-pr. ~5 minutes; it also re-proves cloud posting on the PR that fixes it.

options.label: Merge now
options.description: You merge; I stop the check-ins and unsubscribe. A defect in the hook re-check would surface later as a follow-up item.
